title: Outer Banks Fishing Charters - Fishin Fannatic
specs: 53' Viking Sportfish with air-conditioning and top electronics
33' Center Console with full restroom for inshore trips

Target species include Bluefin tuna, Yellowfin tuna, Bigeye tuna, Billfish, Mahi, Wahoo, Swordfish, Tilefish, Spanish Mackerel, Bluefish, Ribbonfish, King Mackerel, False Albacore, Cobia, Speckled Trout, Sheepshead, Red Drum, Black Drum
All ages welcome; boats are kid friendly
Wear closed toed shoes; no sliders allowed
Up to 6 people on most trips; some trips max 4 people
Multi-party, corporate and tournament trips available; contact for details and pricing

blurb: Guests fish for species including Bluefin tuna, Yellowfin tuna, Bigeye tuna, Billfish, Mahi, Wahoo, Swordfish, Tilefish, Spanish Mackerel, Bluefish, Ribbonfish, King Mackerel, False Albacore, Cobia, Speckled Trout, Sheepshead, Red Drum, and Black Drum.
